description: Widening of National Highways and Reconstruction of Road Infrastructure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method to select contractors to improve several road sections under the widening and improving of National Highways Programme and the Programme for the reconstruction and improvement of roads damaged due to the cyclone Ditwah. Proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contracts to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the relevant High Level Procurement Committees after evaluating the bids received for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.
